summary_ja: この告示を平成28年3月31日から適用し、第5条の一部の改正規定は公布の日から適用する。
summary_en: Provides that this Public Notice applies from March 31, 2016, with certain amending provisions of Article 5 applying from the date of promulgation.
paragraphs: This Public Notice applies from March 31, 2016; provided, however, that the following provisions apply from the date of promulgation. Items (i) through (iv) are omitted. (v) The provisions amending Article 1, Article 3, paragraphs (1) and (2), Article 23, Article 31, Article 47, paragraph (1), item (ii), (b), table, Note 2, ②, Article 65, item (iii), Article 70, paragraph (1), item (i), table, Note, Article 77, paragraph (2), item (ii), and Article 262, table, Note 2 of the Public Notice Establishing Standards for Determining Whether the Capital Adequacy Status of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. Is Appropriate in Light of the Assets, etc. Held by Such Ultimate Designated Parent Company and Its Subsidiary Legal Entities, etc. in Article 5.
